details:
Description: I'm having an issue with VRChat's avatar function. As a quest user, many Quest-compatible avatars that I was previously able to see now appear as a Fallback avatar. I can circumvent this if I have the person clone the avatar from me, but it's happening to more and more avatars lately. This has been an issue since the "Security update". This is happening in every case, regardless of whether the user is my friend, I have view permissions set to full, and other settings that may limit the kinds of avatars I would normally see.

Repro Steps: A PC/Quest user loads an avatar that works on both PC and Quest (as verified by the blue and green bubbles)

Expected: The avatar displays normally for both the PC and Quest users in the world/area, loading the respective version of the avatar.

Actual: Not a 100% occurence, but most of the time, the avatar will not display for Quest users, instead loading the fallback avatar for that user. I'm not sure what allows some avatars to display and others to not. It seems random.

While I do not have Output logs because I am a Quest User, I have heard of this happening to other Quest users
title: Random Quest-compatible avatars do not display for Quest users.
